title: Issue involving YEP and MOG + some other plugin s

posts.author: Leonardotexc
posts.body:
So, this issue happened when i added the YEP_CoreEngine in my game, whenever i try opening the combats it appears the RPG maker error panel, like this:
When i turn the plugin off, i'm able to open the combats normally. Here's the plugin list of the current plugins i use:
Already tried changing the priority of the plugins, but it doesn't seem to work, anyone knows how to fix it?

posts.author: Erif
posts.body: Have you tried turning off the SRD_BattleBackScroll (Nevermind this first part)? If yes, try changing the Scale Battlebacks option on YEP_CoreEngine (Assuming its ON) to false.

posts.author: Leonardotexc
posts.body: I turned it off and it actually worked, thanks for the help.
